mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_PASSWORD_RESETS (target, code_hash, expires_at, consumed_at, attempt_count, created_at) VALUES (#{target}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, NULL, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE code_hash = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, #{now}) >= #{cooldownSeconds}, VALUES(code_hash), code_hash), expires_at = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, #{now}) >= #{cooldownSeconds}, VALUES(expires_at), expires_at), consumed_at = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, #{now}) >= #{cooldownSeconds}, NULL, consumed_at), attempt_count = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, #{now}) >= #{cooldownSeconds}, 0, attempt_count), created_at = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, #{now}) >= #{cooldownSeconds}, VALUES(created_at), created_at)
